queries.acceptance: indexed equality, at most one row examined
queries.explain_sql: SELECT pid FROM player_data WHERE name=(SELECT MIN(name) FROM player_data) LIMIT 1

queries.ordering: event stamp descending, participation ID descending; limit 20
queries.acceptance: no full scan, no temporary table, bounded ordered result
queries.explain_sql: SELECT pe.stamp FROM pkill_info pi JOIN pkill_event pe ON pe.id=pi.event_id WHERE pi.pid=(SELECT MIN(pid) FROM player_data) AND pi.pk_type='VICTIM' ORDER BY pe.stamp DESC,pi.id DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT type_id FROM epic_gain WHERE pid=(SELECT MIN(pid) FROM player_data) AND type=0 UNION SELECT reason_id FROM epic_ledger WHERE pid=(SELECT MIN(pid) FROM player_data) AND reason_type=1

queries.acceptance: PID range with ordered rows and no filesort
queries.explain_sql: SELECT id FROM player_items WHERE pid=(SELECT MIN(pid) FROM player_data) ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM zone_touches WHERE zone_number=(SELECT MIN(number) FROM zones) ORDER BY touched_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 100

queries.acceptance: active race range uses covering order
queries.explain_sql: SELECT char_name,total_frags FROM frag_leaderboard WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND race=(SELECT MIN(race) FROM frag_leaderboard) ORDER BY total_frags DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM quest_trophy WHERE mob_vnum=(SELECT MIN(mob_vnum) FROM quest_trophy) AND timestamp>=CURRENT_DATE-INTERVAL 14 DAY
SELECT outbox_id FROM critical_outbox WHERE status=0 AND next_attempt_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY next_attempt_at,outbox_id LIMIT 100
